notes.title: Update "Do not turn off acceleration when the next wave comes out"
notes.content:
In the past, when a new wave came out, the game slowed down when double speed was enabled to give players time to react.

However, some of our players are so fast that they asked for the option to turn off the slowdown.

We have added this setting in this update.

The translation for this setting may change in the future.

tags.feature: We have added this setting in this update.

notes.title: Update "Support for different screen ratios"
notes.content:
Hi everyone, in this update we've done the following:
[list]
[*] Added support for 4:3 to 16:9 aspect ratio screens
[*] Added the ability to resize the window in game window mode on aspect ratios from 4:3 to 16:9.
[*] Windowed game window size is now remembered and used correctly on startup
[*] Alt+Enter can now be used to toggle between full screen and windowed mode.
[/list]

[*] Added the ability to resize the window in game window mode on aspect ratios from 4:3 to 16:9.
[*] Windowed game window size is now remembered and used correctly on startup
[*] Alt+Enter can now be used to toggle between full screen and windowed mode.

notes.title: Update "Slight improvement of window mode"
notes.content: If windowed mode is selected, the next time the game is started it will start in windowed mode immediately, without temporarily switching to full-screen mode for the duration of loading.

tags.feature: If windowed mode is selected, the next time the game is started it will start in windowed mode immediately, without temporarily switching to full-screen mode for the duration of loading.

notes.title: Update "Cyclic Saves"
notes.content:
In this update we rethought game progress saving.

Before this update each player profile was saved in a separate file and if this file was corrupted, the player would lose all progress.

Now there are three files for saving each profile. The game cyclically writes all the changes in sequence, so that if the last of these files gets corrupted, the player's progress rolls back a small step instead of losing all game progress.

notes.title: "Long time no see" update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! In this update:

 - Death ray now does not disappear after releasing the mouse button
 - Death ray can now be moved around the map after releasing the mouse button
 - Support tower now increases the support radius of other support towers
 - Range display of towers is now correctly updated when a support tower applies a range aura
 - When resurrecting a enemy, its hp cannot be less than 1, which caused the robot "Phoenix" to be resurrected a fourth time
 - Fixed a bug where when the destruction of the object on the map, if the player turned on a pause, the object went into a cyclic animation and will not be removed from the map
 - Fixed the game crash when leaving a level and the projectile thinks it should kill a enemy but the enemy is already destroyed
 - Kamikaze enemies now always explode at any point on a rock or gate
 - Fixed gold coins and rubies falling out, they no longer fall under towers
 - Fixed block and gate regeneration
 - Fixed available cells for tower construction on 37 levels
 - Fixed aura effect position on base towers 
 - Returned an icon for the burning effect of a enemy 
 - Improved transition from menu to loading screen
 - Improved check that an improvement cannot be bought a second time 
 - Improved tutorial
 - Multiple localization improvements
 - Improved looped sound playback

notes.title: Big localization update!
notes.content:
Here comes the big localization update!

We have translated our game into 6 new languages - Czech, Greek, Romanian, Swedish Thai and Vietnamese.
We have also improved about 30% of the lines in all 18 existing languages to make them more understandable.
We did it with great help of our players - Paweł Dubiłowicz, Aliaksandr Haradzetski, Juanje Mosquera, Joseph, Frank van Schaik and shin.

Also we found and fix some bugs!

We try to make our game as good as possible for our amazing players!
Thank you for playing our game!

notes.title: Update 1.0.16
notes.content:
In this update we added possibility to disable tutorial, hotkeys and Chinese Traditional.

List of hotkeys are here:

On level screen:
1 - select machine gun tower
2 - select energy tower
3 - select cryogenic tower
4 - select support tower
5 - select factory
R - select concrete block
T - select minefield
F - turn on death ray (attach ray to mouse cursor till end of ray timer or by pressing any button)
Space - start level, then speed up and speed down game
Esc - pause and unpause
R - when pause window is open - restart game

W or Up - move map up
S or Down - move map down

When tower is selected:
W - upgrade tower
S - sell tower
Q - upgrade tower to left advanced one or switch support tower
E - upgrade tower to right advanced one or switch support tower
A - info about tower
D - drop tower selection

Hope hot keys help you play more comfortable!

I would like to thank Smug for reminding on hotkeys and GreenTomato for comics string fix.

Thank you for playing our game! :fiery_heart:

tags.feature: In this update we added possibility to disable tutorial, hotkeys and Chinese Traditional.

notes.title: Update 1.0.11
notes.content:
Hey, hey! We are not dead yet!
In this version we added windowed mode and volume controls for sound and music.
Also we did some gameplay changes: no more rubies and gold penalties in passed levels.
And we fixed some bugs and updated frameworks which we use in game, so game should work faster than ever!

BTW, In near future we're planning to release free level pack with 5 levels, stay tuned!

--------------------------------------------------

Всем привет! Внезапно мы выпустили обновление!
Добавили оконный режим и управление громкостью звуками и музыкой.
А ещё мы убрали понижающий коэфициент выпадения рубинов и золота при перепрохождении уровня.
Кроме того мы исправили некоторые баги и пересобрали игру на свежих технологиях, так что всё должно работать ещё лучше!

Тем временем мы делаем бесплатный набор из пяти уровней, так что оставайтесь на связи!
